339-677-1322-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-1322-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3534-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-3534-8105.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

586-1472-5626-8095.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-5626-8095.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

4153-6797--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4153-6797--5--195.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2104-3277-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Izzet Chronarch.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Izzet Chronarch from exile to the battlefield.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3908-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3908-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Dack's Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3908-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2074-5686-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

413-856-4321-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
413-856-4321-7422.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 3, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

4186-5870-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-5870-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}
Repeat from step 2.

2440-5223-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-5223-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

1394-2060-5256-6774-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Loading Zone.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Loading Zone.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

6524-7042.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6524-7042.description:
Declare Appa as an attacker, triggering its ability, airbending All-Out Assault.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Cast All-Out Assault from exile by paying {2}.
When All-Out Assault enters, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase. At the beginning of that phase, All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Repeat.

1479-5621-7201.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5621-7201.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4676-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

225-1669-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
225-1669-5531-6621.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1669-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining triggers.
Repeat from step 1.

1809-2104-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Returned Pastcaller each turn.
1809-2104-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Returned Pastcaller by paying its mana cost.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Returned Pastcaller from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1987-2187-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2187-4377-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

1013-4067-5806.notablePrerequisites:
Thieving Otter does not have summoning sickness.
Hypervolt Grasp attached to Thieving Otter.
1013-4067-5806.description:
Activate Thieving Otter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Thieving Otter triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Thieving Otter.
Repeat.

2103-2499-2788-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
2103-2499-2788-3634.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1656-3371-4824.manaNeeded: {4}, plus enough mana to pay for the nonland card's mana cost minus {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
1656-3371-4824.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one nonland card in hand.
1656-3371-4824.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Codie's ability by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Necrotic Ooze triggers for each time you activated Codie's ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each nonland card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

610-717-779-3251.description:
Cast Psychic Miasma by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Archmage Emeritus triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
If Dakmor Salvage is in your graveyard, instead replace drawing a card with milling two cards, and returning Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Psychic Miasma, discarding Dakmor Salvage and returning Psychic Miasma to your hand.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1846-1987-2493-4568.description:
Cast High Tide.
Tap the Island for {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker targeting Archaeomancer and the Island.
Archaeomancer triggers twice, returning Ghostly Flicker and High Tide from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide.
Tap the Island for {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker targeting Archaeomancer and the Island.
Archaeomancer triggers twice, returning Ghostly Flicker and High Tide from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide.
Tap the island for {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat, gaining mana each itteration.

813-4305-4872.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Scholar of the Ages.
813-4305-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Scholar of the Ages.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp to your hand.
Repeat.
